parts.text: What is true about these separations?

options.text: Rohit removes an unwanted component; Anaya collects a useful component.
Both separations have the same purpose: only to throw everything away.
Anaya is removing paneer as unwanted waste, not collecting it as useful.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Rohit sieves husk out of wheat flour so the flour is fine. Anaya drains curdled milk through a cloth to collect paneer.

part_answers.answer: Sieving husk removes an unwanted part from flour; draining for paneer collects a useful component. The purposes differ.

teacher.key_rationale: Sieving husk removes an unwanted part. Collecting paneer gathers a useful component. Throwing everything away or treating paneer as waste misses the purposes.
